name: Detail callouts: cut-out, the card lifts off
when: The voice names the one or two best details of a frozen shot. Each detail lifts off the still as a card with a numbered tab, then drops back into its hole. Slower and more premium than screenshot2-A; it needs details that read as a cut-out rectangle.
anchor: Each card lands on its word: `at1`, `at2`, `at3` (each lifts 0.47 s before).

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.shot: the frozen shot: a 1920x1080 still in the project's assets/
vars.shot_blur: the same still, blurred and dimmed to 60 %, baked with ffmpeg (no tint): ffmpeg -i shot.jpg -vf "gblur=sigma=6:steps=3,colorchannelmixer=rr=0.6:gg=0.6:bb=0.6" -q:v 2 shot_blur.jpg
vars.shot_lit: the same still a touch brighter, shown on the lifted cards: ffmpeg -i shot.jpg -vf "eq=gamma=1.15:contrast=1.04:saturation=1.1" -q:v 2 shot_lit.jpg
vars.count: the number on the first tab (shown as 01); the next tabs count up by one
vars.label1: tab 1's label, sentence case, as the voice names the detail (26 characters at most); label2 and label3 the same
vars.cut1_x: cut-out 1 on the 1920x1080 still: left edge in pixels (cut1_y top, cut1_w width, cut1_h height); same for cut2_* and cut3_*: find it with find_box.mjs (grid, zoom, check, then the blind check), never by eye
vars.card1_scale: how much card 1 grows once lifted (1.6 validated); card2_scale 2.4, card3_scale 2.5
vars.card1_x: where card 1 lands on screen: left edge (card1_y top); its tab sits 16 px under it. Keep the landed card and its tab inside x 96-1824, y 54-1026
vars.at1: seconds after the start: card 1 lands (it lifts 0.47 s before; at least 0.5)
vars.at2: seconds after the start: card 2 lands; at least 1.6 s after at1 (card 1 drops back 1.07 s before)
vars.at3: seconds after the start: card 3 lands; at least 1.6 s after at2
vars.out: seconds after the start: card 3's tab leaves and the card drops back 0.2 s later; the scene can end 0.6 s after `out`, or hold the sharp shot up to 0.7 s as validated

changed: A card drops back into its hole in 9 frames instead of 12 (exit 0.3 s): the same curve with its first and last 1.5 frames trimmed. The shot and its blurred and brighter copies are file values; the tab numbers come from `count`. The ground behind the still is gone: the still always covers the frame.
